name: ChipGroup
summary: A set of chips under one label: values someone picked (input chips) or filters they turn on (filter chips, one or several). Owns the label, description, message, empty state, the "+n" overflow and the keys.
a11y: Labelled by its visible label. Input chips are a `list`; filter chips a `group` of checkboxes or a `radiogroup`. One Tab stop: arrows move between chips. After a removal, focus moves to the next chip, else the previous, and the removal is announced politely. The "+n" chip is a real button naming how many more.

keys.action: remove the input chip in focus

props.name: label
props.description: The group's visible label: what the chips are ("Recipients", "Status").

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the label, when the chips need explaining.

props.name: selection
props.description: `none`: input chips (values someone picked). `single`: filter chips, one on (radios). `multiple`: filter chips, any on (checkboxes). Default `none`.

props.name: value
props.description: Filter groups: the ids that are on.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Input groups: removes a chip. Without it the chips are read-only.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Input groups: a chip's primary action (open the person's card).

props.name: maxVisible
props.description: Shows this many chips, then a "+n" chip that shows the rest.

props.name: error
props.description: One message for the group: what's wrong and how to fix it. Pair it with `invalid` chips.

props.name: empty
props.description: Said in the chips' place when there are none.
